comment: Ordered list of the database migrations the CRM release and the SaaS pilot need. The SQL files stay where they are; this file adds order, dependencies, rollbacks and a probe that says whether a migration's effect is present. Never edit a migration that has been applied anywhere: add a new one (the runner refuses on a checksum change).

migrations.note: Smart Quote versions (M1 of the repair release).
Payment ledger guard, revision 2 (M3). The old application code returns 500 on payments once this exists: deploy the new backend first.

migrations.probe: select to_regclass('public.companies') is not null and to_regprocedure('app.default_company_id()') is not null
migrations.note: Companies, memberships, tenant role, row-level security, same-company reference checks. Run scripts/saas/phase2-preflight.sql first.
Company ownership inside the invoice trigger and invoice_save_atomic paths.

migrations.probe: select to_regclass('public.document_counters') is not null and to_regprocedure('public.next_document_number(text,text,text,int)') is not null
migrations.note: Atomic per-company invoice numbers. Refuses to run for the founding company without an owner-set floor (insert into app.config ... 'document_floor.sunchaser.invoice.<year>').

migrations.probe: select exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conname = 'settings_company_key_scope')
migrations.note: Settings and website content keys of companies other than the founding one must be '<company>:<key>' (the database enforces what the application does).

migrations.probe: select to_regclass('public.saas_subscriptions') is not null and to_regprocedure('public.saas_create_company(text,text,text,integer,jsonb,jsonb)') is not null
migrations.note: Plans, manual subscriptions and payment ledger, audit trail, plan limits enforced by triggers, atomic company onboarding. The pilot plan is a placeholder (pricing is undecided).

migrations.probe: select exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'invoices' and column_name = 'issuance_snapshot')
migrations.note: New invoices keep the bank accounts and company terms they were issued with (write-once). Older invoices stay NULL and print from current settings, labelled legacy. The backend works with or without this column.
Plan storage limit (max_storage_mb) and the append-only history of company settings changes. The backend works without it (no storage limit, no history).

migrations.probe: select to_regclass('public.saas_storage_reservations') is not null and to_regprocedure('public.saas_storage_reserve(text,bigint,bigint,bigint,bigint,integer,integer)') is not null
migrations.note: Atomic storage reservations across server processes: a per-company locked reserve/settle function pair. Pilot companies' uploads need it (without it they are refused with a retryable 'could not verify storage'); the founding company and single-company mode never use it.
